final: WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(account_id) FROM account) AS avg_count FROM per_account), above_avg AS (SELECT account_id, record_count, record_count - avg_count AS excess FROM per_account CROSS JOIN overall WHERE record_count > avg_count) SELECT account_id, record_count, excess, record_count - AVG(record_count) OVER () AS deviation_from_mean FROM above_avg ORDER BY deviation_from_mean DESC LIMIT 10
